title: FEEDBACK FORENSICS: A TOOLKIT TO MEASURE AI PERSONALITY

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise comparison of model responses using LLM-as-a-judge to detect human or model preferences for verbosity, structured formatting, numbered lists, and markdown usage (e.g., bold/italics).
Using AI annotators to evaluate pairwise responses to measure how often models agree with the user (even if factually incorrect), flatter the user, or reinforce the user's beliefs and anger.

Measuring behavioral idiosyncrasies such as politeness, enthusiasm, casual versus formal language, and avoidant tone using an LLM-based relative annotation toolkit to compute the 'strength' and relevance of these traits.
